##Introductory Code

```{r Loading Relevant Materials}
#I begin by loading the necessary R packages which will enable me to utilize a variety of functions.
library(readxl)
library(tidyverse) #For general data visualization functions
library(ggplot2) #For the ggplot graphing function
library(dplyr) #For the Pipe Syntax Operator

#Next I import and take a cursory glance at the 1988 NELS dataset.
NELS <- read_excel("~/Documents/R Data/NELS.xlsx")
View(NELS)
```

```{r Building the Average Academic Achievement Vector}
#In order to conduct an empirical analysis of the 1988 NELS dataset, I will first compare a variety of qualitative and quantitative variables with each students academic achievement.

#To this end, I will average out each students achievement in Reading, Math, Social Studies, and Science in 12th grade to build a vector of their average academic achievement.
`Academic Achievement in 12th Grade` <- (NELS$`Reading Achievement in Twelfth Grade` + NELS$`Math Achievement in Twelfth Grade` + NELS$`Social Studies Achievement in Twelfth Grade`+ NELS$`Science Achievement in Twelfth Grade`)/4

#I now add this new vector to the original 1988 NELS dataset
NELS$`Academic Achievement in 12th Grade` = `Academic Achievement in 12th Grade`
View(NELS)
```

#PART I

##QUALITATIVE VARIABLES

###SCHOOL ELEMENTS - Location | Other Properties (synonym: attributes?)

####Location - Urbanicity | Geographic Region

```{r Variable X - Urbanicity}


rural_achievement <- NELS[NELS$Urbanicity == 'Rural', 'Academic Achievement in 12th Grade']
mod_rural_achievement <- unlist(rural_achievement)
summary(rural_achievement)
sd(mod_rural_achievement)

suburban_achievement <- NELS[NELS$Urbanicity == 'Suburban', 'Academic Achievement in 12th Grade']
mod_suburban_achievement <- unlist(suburban_achievement)
summary(suburban_achievement)
sd(mod_suburban_achievement)

urban_achievement <- NELS[NELS$Urbanicity == 'Urban', 'Academic Achievement in 12th Grade']
mod_urban_achievement <- unlist(urban_achievement)
summary(urban_achievement)
sd(mod_urban_achievement)

urbanicitycount <- NELS %>%
  group_by(Urbanicity) %>%
  summarize(Count = n())
print(urbanicitycount)

df_rural_achievement <- data.frame(rural_achievement, check.names = FALSE)
df_suburban_achievement <- data.frame(suburban_achievement, check.names = FALSE)
df_urban_achievement <- data.frame(urban_achievement, check.names = FALSE)

df_urbanicity_list <- list(`Rural` = df_rural_achievement, `Suburban` = df_suburban_achievement, `Urban` = df_urban_achievement)
df_urbanicity_combined <- bind_rows(df_urbanicity_list, .id = "Urbanicity")

x_var = "Academic Achievement in 12th Grade"
y_var = "Urbanicity"
ggplot(df_urbanicity_combined, mapping = aes(x = .data[[x_var]], y = .data[[y_var]], fill = Urbanicity)) + geom_boxplot(alpha = .5) + labs(x = x_var, y = y_var, caption = "Source: NELS 1988") + theme(legend.position = "none")

ggplot(df_urbanicity_combined, mapping = aes(x = `Academic Achievement in 12th Grade`, fill = Urbanicity)) + geom_density(alpha = .5) + labs(caption = "Source: NELS 1988")

```
